SASBDB entry SASDJ66  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDJ66/)

Publication: Biophysical characterization of the complex between the iron-responsive transcription factor Fep1 and DNA.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1007/s00249-020-01489-y

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDJ66/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.

q cut (round 9, 2026-11-13): the script fits q <= 0.45 A^-1 and leaves out the noise tail: SEC-SAXS curve of a 6.8 kDa duplex at the noise floor beyond 0.2; above the cut 43 of 95 points non-positive, mean I/sigma 0.1 (151 of 1029 in the whole curve).
Every other entry without such a tail is fitted over its whole curve.
